method: Targeted checks in a fresh integrated-browser page, eight new CSS/contrast regression tests, and exact canvas SHA-256 comparison with the recorded 1.1.5 baseline.

checks.observed: Header resolves to #0B1120, story panels to #132238, light headings to #F4F7FB, and copper-derived accents decorate the landing page. Desktop screenshots were inspected.
Workspace resolves to #F3F6FB, map card/input surfaces remain white, and the canvas has filter=none and opacity=1. Space decoration stays outside the working surfaces.

Computed brand, navigation, story, input, helper, primary-button and active-map-view pairs measure 17.52, 11.71, 9.94, 13.13, 6.20, 6.11 and 6.11 to 1. Unit checks also cover the lightest designed dark base, control boundaries and focus rings.

Dark-header keyboard focus uses the visible amber outline; light-workspace Tab/Space selection still activates Whole area and updates the saved map image. Exactly one map-view option remains selected.

At actual 390/320 px viewport widths, document widths remain 375/305 px across landing, destination, expanded activity help, review and brief. Map buttons stay equal-width and at least 44 px high. The mobile orbit is hidden and sparse stars stay in the gutters.

Optical, elevation, slope, thermal and opportunity canvas PNG data-URL SHA-256 values exactly match theme-map-baseline.json for the same nominal P plan. No map recoloring, filter or opacity treatment was introduced.
Nominal P retains the 61.92 min displayed margin. Adding 63 observation minutes retains TIME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, -1.0830014565751185 min raw margin, and the 20-minute reserve.
Original A retains NO_MODELED_ROUTE with null time under the nominal preset. Existing textual status explanations and semantic status colors remain present.
Print-media body, workspace and brief are white; workspace border/shadow are removed. Header, map controls and footer are hidden. The dark frame does not print.
A view change in Save brief updates the actual brief image to the current canvas. JSON retains versions, source records, current comparison, reserve and unavailable values.

With reduced-motion preference enabled, active animations count is zero and both decorative pseudo-elements report animation-name=none. Decoration is noninteractive CSS; there are no external font/image URLs or new production dependencies.
117 unit tests, five actual-data integration checks and 30 static-delivery checks pass. The model and scientific-input preservation guards remain required for release.

boundaries: Representative computed contrast checks are not a full accessibility audit or a human usability study.
Pointer/keyboard behavior at mobile viewport sizes was checked; a physical touch-device test was not performed.
Normal operating-system print/download dialogs and actual Rumahweb hosting remain separate acceptance checks.

The older inactive browser page stalled during reference capture; a fresh page loaded normally and provided all baseline and theme measurements. The served module/configuration both returned HTTP 200.
